summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Rezolve AI plc, a foreign private issuer, reporting two items: a waiver deed related to a previously announced acquisition of Reward Loyalty UK Limited, under which certain sellers waived $14 million in warranty retention in exchange for warrants to purchase 4.67 million ordinary shares, and a press release reaffirming FY26 revenue guidance. Neither constitutes a new special-situation event; the waiver is a post-closing contractual adjustment, and the press release is ordinary business communications. This filing is not a special situation.
